subject: Provider-neutral token and credential governance without mandatory KWallet dependency
decisions: Secret values are never stored in QSettings, repository configuration, logs, telemetry, Evidence or exports.
Only typed CredentialReference/SecretRef metadata may be persisted outside the credential backend.
KWallet is optional and replaceable; it is never a mandatory build, install or runtime dependency.
OS keychain/Secret Service, systemd credential references, environment references and external secret providers are supported backend patterns.
Provider tokens must use an Authorization header or credential channel when supported and must not be injected into embedded web DOM state.
AI input/output/context token budgets are governed separately from credential secrets.
Token usage observability is redacted and cannot contain bearer values.
